raw_segments.text: But how will you go on living? What will you live for? Cried Sonya, how is it possible now? Why how can you talk to your mother?
Oh, what will become of them now? But what am I saying? You have abandoned your mother and your sister already.
He has abandoned them already. Oh God, she cried. Why he knows it all himself.
How how can he live by himself? What will become of you now?
